c_cpp_toolchain.name: Standard C/C++ Toolchain
c_cpp_toolchain.prepareCommand: sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -y && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential cmake pkg-config gdb valgrind && sudo rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

go_cgo_libvips.name: Go CGO Image Processing with libvips
go_cgo_libvips.prepareCommand: sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -y && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends pkg-config libvips-dev libglib2.0-dev && sudo rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

python_glibc_wheels.name: Python Data Science with Pre-Compiled glibc Wheels
python_glibc_wheels.prepareCommand: sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -y && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends python3-dev python3-venv build-essential libssl-dev libffi-dev && sudo rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
python_glibc_wheels.installCommand: pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel && pip install numpy pandas scipy torch --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu

nodejs_native_addons.name: Node.js node-gyp & Sharp Native Addons
nodejs_native_addons.prepareCommand: sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -y && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends python3 make g++ libvips-dev && sudo rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
nodejs_native_addons.buildCommand: npm ci && npm run build && npm prune --production

system_diagnostics.name: Low-Level Diagnostics & Syscall Tracing
system_diagnostics.prepareCommand: sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -y && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends strace lsof procps net-tools curl dnsutils htop && sudo rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
